completeness.why: Every site takes the hidden/group/income selection from shouldFillCategory (copyPreviousMonth with 'skip-hidden', setZero with 'include', the averages via getAverageCategories with 'require-visible-group', whose SQL no longer filters hidden rows) and the sign from averageToBudgetAmount (set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg); sites only pass their own rows and the tracking flag.

interface.why: A three-valued HiddenPolicy names exactly the real variations, including the preserved inconsistencies (setZero writing hidden categories, averages skipping categories with a missing group), with no speculative options; the sign rule is a separate small function.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden/income rules and the sign inversion were removed from the sites and now exist only in fill-categories.ts; nothing is left reshaped at the call sites.
